maintenance_led.reason: Sells packaged food brands (Green Giant, Crisco, Ortega); consumables used up, not maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from grocery retailers and consumers buying packaged foods, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Built its portfolio of 50+ brands by acquiring established food brands; website states commitment to acquiring brands.

mission_critical.reason: Shelf-stable grocery products; retailers and consumers can easily switch to competing brands.

notes: Acquisition pace has slowed recently as the company has focused on debt and divestitures, so the serial acquirer answer is somewhat uncertain.
